analysis.overall: You spent 83% of your day in range with a great average of 121 mg/dL, though a few low dips and late-morning stacked corrections caused sharp swings.

events.title: Midday low drop
events.description: Glucose dropped sharply to 60 mg/dL right before lunch, but rebounded smoothly back into target as you ate.

events.title: Post-dinner low after site change
events.description: A 3.1u dinner bolus pulled your glucose down quickly from 184 to 60 mg/dL around the same time you changed your infusion site.

events.title: Late evening correction spike
events.description: After an undelivered bolus alert and a 30g late snack, glucose climbed to 199 mg/dL before coming down with correction doses.

events.title: Overnight brief dip
events.description: A quick low reading of 63 mg/dL occurred in early morning sleeping hours, but it self-corrected rapidly back to steady levels.

events.title: Morning spike to 240 mg/dL
events.description: Stacking two morning carb entries (40g and 15g) alongside frequent small correction boluses pushed glucose to its daily high.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for giving multiple small correction boluses close together when eating back-to-back meals, as active insulin can stack up quickly.
